name: us021-state-version-changed
description: T021 [US2]: reconcile a three-story specification to completion, edit the recorded run-state document's extension_version to a value that cannot be the real one, then reconcile again. contracts/run-state.md §3 row 'extension_version differs': the second run must be a full reconcile — the sentinel value must not survive into the freshly re-recorded state (a bridge upgrade must not be masked by a stale document, §8 invariant S7).
